title: Fiji Queens Road
slogan: Nadi to Suva · 148 km home again

waypoints.name: Nadi
waypoints.advice: Nadi is where the day begins. Next is Sigatoka, 73 km on.

waypoints.name: Sigatoka
waypoints.advice: Sigatoka comes up 73 km in. Next is Coral Coast, 73 km on.

waypoints.name: Coral Coast
waypoints.advice: 146 km in you reach Coral Coast. Next is Pacific Harbour, 73 km on.

waypoints.name: Pacific Harbour
waypoints.advice: Pacific Harbour, late in the day. Next is Suva, 73 km on.

waypoints.name: Suva
waypoints.advice: Back at Suva. That is the ride.

sections.advice: Nadi → Sigatoka is 52 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Sigatoka → Coral Coast is 13 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Coral Coast → Pacific Harbour is 64 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.
Pacific Harbour → Suva is 51 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the named road Fiji Queens Road. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.

scenicChapters.title: Fiji Queens Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 21 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
